name: Single-compartment Ca_HVA causal closed-loop microcanary
scope: Authentic NEURON one-compartment Ca_HVA + passive leak teacher, compared with frozen Task 5 gate primitives coupled to an explicit voltage solver. No 642-segment claim and no learned voltage network.
arms: authentic NEURON teacher with Ca_HVA + pas
extracted exact Ca_HVA gate formula + same semi-implicit voltage solver
frozen linear LUT-513 gate + same voltage solver
frozen physical-tau width32 gate, all three seeds + same voltage solver
causal_contract: Every surrogate arm updates gates from its own V_k, computes analytic Ca_HVA current, and advances its own V_(k+1). No teacher V after initial state is used in its rollout.

solver_calibration_gate.policy: If the extracted-formula closed-loop arm fails this comparison to NEURON, candidate-vs-NEURON errors are not interpreted as gate representation effects. Save and return the forensic report rather than silently promoting a candidate.

selection_policy: No candidate retraining, seed selection or threshold tuning. Canonical 1x and deliberately stressed 4x gbar are reported separately. This is a diagnostic microcanary, not a sealed full-neuron test.
limitations: The voltage solver is explicit in structure but not learned; dynamic E_Ca, calcium concentrations, other ion channels, synapses, axial tree and full teacher morphology are excluded. GPU timings are not a primary endpoint.
